_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
We ndi Mwali {player_id} mu nkhondo ya Liar's Dice ya {num_players} wali.
Mawiliro a nkhondo:
- Pa nkhondo yako, mwaweza kugwiritsa ntchito:
  1) Kugwiritsa bid yatsopano yenye malo ambayo ndi yapakwiro au nyuso yapakwiro (au zote) kuliko bid yamwamalo; koma '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Kukutuma bid yamwamalo kwa kulemba '[Call]'.

Iwe ukutuma:
  - Iwe nambari ya kweli ya thambo la nyuso kati ka mawiliro onse ndi chache kuliko bid, wabidizayo wa mwamalo akupereka mawiliro.
  - Ina, ukutumayo akupereka mawiliro.
Mwali amene akufika mawiliro a zero akutengedwa. Mwali wamwamalo wawina.

board.new_round:
New round - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Your current Dice are: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mwali {current_player_id} akutuma! Nambari ya kweli ya nyuso {face_value} ndi {count}, ambayo ndi chache kuliko {quantity}.
Mwali {loser_id} (wabidizayo wa mwamalo) akupereka mawiliro.
call.caller_loses:
Mwali {current_player_id} akutuma! Nambari ya kweli ya nyuso {face_value} ndi {count}, ambayo ndi >= {quantity}.
Mwali {loser_id} (wakutumayo) akupereka mawiliro.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Kugwiritsa ntchito kosiyanitsa bwino ngati '[Bid: X, Y]' au '[Call]'. Kugwiritsa ntchito kwa: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Malo aatsopano {new_quantity} ambalo ndi opabwino kuliko la sasa {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Thambo la nyuso latsopano {new_face_value} lililo pabwino kuliko la sasa {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Ivyo ŵapika vikayananga waka na ivyo ŵakapelekanga pa nyengo iyo.
bid_reason.face_range: Vinthu ivyo vikuwoneka kuti ni vyapadera vikwenera kuŵa pakati pa 1 na 6.
